data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 the Syndicate released GBP 39.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2016: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Marine Divisions (2016: primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2017.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the UK Division to Antares Syndicate 1274
prior_year_events.impact_description: Syndicate 1084 will RITC the part of the 2015 Year of Account which comprises the UK Division book of business to Antares Syndicate 1274. Due to the Syndicate's existing reinsurance arrangement the UK Division closing reserves are net nil (gross GBP 199.7m) and therefore the RITC will be for a nominal consideration of GBP 1.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,830.6m. During 2017 the Syndicate released GBP 39.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (a ~2.15% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding), driven predominantly by favourable claims development in the Energy and Marine divisions. The Managing Agent also noted a 2015 RITC transaction for the UK Division (gross GBP 199.7m, net nil due to reinsurance) which impacts reserve presentation.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement sourced from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative which states a release of GBP 39.4m (used here as gross). A gross claims development table (claims triangle) is present and the triangle extraction suggests materially different gross movements (triangle-based gross PYD aggregated ~+394.7m adverse). Possible reasons include RITC distortions, differences between 'technical reserves' wording (may be net or gross), or table-reading alignment errors from scanned images. The reported -39.4m figure was used as the principal PYD because it is explicit in the movement note; users should treat the prior-year gross number as subject to this ambiguity.
